description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EventBusRegistrationAdapter' that binds a 'RegistrationService' to the Vert.x event bus for handling device registration messages within the Eclipse Hono framework. It processes registration requests, supports tracing via OpenTracing, and provides hooks for subclasses to implement additional functionalities.

classes.name: EventBusRegistrationAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class that binds a RegistrationService to the Vert.x event bus, providing the logic for processing registration requests, including tracing support, request validation, and custom operation handling.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming device registration messages and routes them to specific handlers based on the operation type.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the RegistrationService instance to which requests are forwarded. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Returns the address on the Vert.x event bus where registration messages are received.

methods.name: processCustomRegistrationMessage
methods.description: Handles non-standard registration operations. Default implementation fails with 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: isGatewaySupportedForDevice
methods.description: Determines if a gateway can act on behalf of a device based on registration info.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new OpenTracing child span for tracing registration service operations, annotating it with tenant, device, and gateway IDs if provided.

methods.name: handleUnimplementedOperation
methods.description: Handles unsupported operations by returning a 501 Not Implemented response.

methods.name: isGatewayAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a gateway is authorized to act on behalf of a device based on registration data.

methods.name: getRegistrationAssertionCacheDirective
methods.description: Determines caching directives for registration assertions, defaulting to a 300-second max age.

methods.name: getResultPayload
methods.description: Builds a JSON payload containing device ID and registration data for client responses.
